items.title: Youth Summer Series Writing Workshop: Making Your Character Shine
items.summary: Join authors Sarena Nanua and Sasha Nanua for an engaging Author Talk and interactive workshop, “Making Your Character Shine.”

items.title: Summer Berry Salad
items.summary: Join us for an interactive, hands-on workshop that reconnects participants to the earth through the lens of Indigenous food sovereignty.

items.title: Mosaic Festival 2026
items.summary: The Mosaic Festival is the longest-running multidisciplinary South Asian arts festival in the Greater Toronto Area. Held annually at Mississauga Celebration Square, it is a vibrant, free, two-day celebration of South Asian heritage, featuring a high-energy mix of international headliners, local talent, and immersive cultural experiences.

items.title: Central Lions Farmers Market – Wednesdays
items.summary: Stop by the Central Lions Farmers Market this summer in Mississauga and experience a lively local shopping destination! m. m. m. m. m.

items.title: Port Credit Ribfest X 2026
items.summary: Port Credit Ribfest X 2026 is presented by Gelateria Italiana and held at Port Credit Memorial Park. Produced by Ontario Festival Group, the event features North America’s top rib teams serving award-winning BBQ favourites, including smoked ribs, pulled pork, brisket, BBQ chicken, smoked sausage, and massive beef “Dino” ribs.

items.title: Jurassic Quest
items.summary: Embark on an unforgettable prehistoric adventure at , where North America’s largest moving, roaring, and life-like dinosaurs come to life in a fully immersive walk-through experience for the whole family. Featuring towering animatronic dinosaurs, interactive exhibits, and hands-on activities, Jurassic Quest invites guests to step back in time and explore the wonders of the Jurassic era like never before.

items.title: Mississauga Latin Festival
items.summary: Celebrate the vibrant cultures of Latin America with a festival full of music, movement, and flavour. From the rhythms of salsa and reggaeton to colourful performances and lively entertainment, this is where the community comes together to dance, connect, and celebrate. Enjoy live music, cultural showcases, and dynamic dance performances that bring the spirit of Latin culture to life. Indulge in authentic cuisine, explore local vendors, and soak in an atmosphere that’s as warm as it is electric.

items.title: First Friday Market
items.summary: Spend a summer evening in the heart of Streetsville at First Fridays in The ’Ville. Taking place on the first Friday of June, July, and August, the Streetsville Village Square transforms into a lively open-air market featuring local vendors, great food, and live music. Visitors can explore a curated mix of handcrafted goods, small-batch food offerings, and more than 25 vendors to browse, sample, and shop. The atmosphere is brought to life with performances from local artists as part of the City of Mississauga’s Summer Music Concert Series.

items.title: Rad Ride & Shine 2026
items.summary: Rad Ride & Shine 2026 is hitting Mississauga! They're bringing a first-of-its-kind, three-part BMX festival to the city, celebrating riding culture, community, and the perfect balance in everyday life. What to expect: The Ride Out: A massive, permit-secured group ride through the heart of Mississauga. Own the streets with them! The Comps: High-flying Freestyle, Flatland, and Ramp action from local riders and seasoned pros. Also, they are hosting a Freestyle Flatland Trick workshop for juniors, led by seasoned pros!

items.title: Movie Night in The Square: Zootopia 2
items.summary: Spend an evening outdoors in Streetsville and enjoy a movie under the stars with a screening of Zootopia 2 . Gather your family and friends, bring along blankets or lawn chairs, and settle into the Village Square for a fun-filled night. The movie will start at dusk, but there will be plenty of activities to keep you entertained beforehand—so be sure to arrive early and enjoy the full experience.
